codeReview.summary: Pass. The implementation adds a localhost-only, allowlisted `?qaFixture=` runtime path in `app.js` that loads deterministic fixture CSVs for manual QA while preserving the default live Google Sheets fetch path when the param is absent, invalid, or used off localhost. Lifecycle messaging and recency labels clearly identify fixture mode, and `tests/dashboard-harness.spec.js` adds behavior coverage proving the manual toggle works without Playwright network interception.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared testing guidance is now stale: it still says Playwright route interception is the dependable path for deterministic fixture-backed scenarios because agent-browser route mocking is unreliable, but this feature introduced a localhost-only `?qaFixture=` runtime path specifically so manual QA can exercise fixture scenarios without brittle interception.
